migrationRules.tenantBoundary: one database per tenant, one database principal per tenant
migrationRules.orgId: remove org_id from destination tenant tables only after source filtering and reconciliation
migrationRules.sessions: revoke all legacy sessions; require fresh login
migrationRules.userIdentity: copy tenant users/roles/permissions into that tenant database; never globally deduplicate
migrationRules.platformIdentity: extract only verified super-admin accounts to platform_admins
migrationRules.files: copy each org upload tree into tenant-specific storage and verify checksums
